role: Senior Front-End Developer · UI/UX Designer · Tech Lead
quote: Front-end developer. Incurable traveler. Writer in the making. All in the same woman.

about.heading: About me
about.body_before: Brazilian by birth, Sicilian by sunset. Three years ago I claimed my Italian citizenship and moved to Sicily — my time zone is the Mediterranean now. I've spent 5+ years building interfaces and, for the last several, working as front-end developer
about.body_after: designer — from Figma to code. But I'm not only the developer who delivers: I'm also the woman who travels, writes, reads and turns life into a collection of stories.

jobs.desc: I lead the front-end of LIVE, a large-scale streaming platform for the Portuguese Ministry of Health. React, Next.js & TypeScript with a styled MUI design system and WebRTC (Kurento) streaming — also acting as UI/UX designer and building the Figma prototypes from inception, while leading a small team.

Built complex government systems — SCOT (traffic-ticketing) in Ionic + React, and SIARL, a coastal-resource management platform in React/Next.js + Redux. Data-driven UI, responsive layouts and UX refinement at national scale; designed the SIARL Figma prototype from the start.
Mobile & web features for the MEUPET app with Ionic, Angular and Firebase — including a geolocation-based lost & found and a nutrition BMI calculator for animals.
Full-stack web & mobile with PHP, JavaScript, Ionic and Angular — campaign sites with back-offices, systems analysis and databases. Where I fell in love with front-end and design.
